results.desc: concat on array-like appends object (spec: no spread of array-likes)
join null and undefined become empty
slice before start is full copy
sort powers of 10 mixed with small ints (ToString)
sort negative ints mixed with positives (ToString: -2 < -5 < 0 < 10 < 3)
sort sparse: values compact front, holes stay holes at end (V8 verified)
sort comparator mixed numbers and strings
sort comparator NaN pins deterministic order (carve-out D7)
splice absent deleteCount deletes to end
toString on plain object falls back to Object tag
fill explicit undefined end is treated as len
includes matches holes as undefined (V8 behavior)
flat explicit undefined depth is treated as 1
from preserves holes as undefined elements (Node behavior)
from without mapFn copies holes as undefined elements
of single undefined is an element
keys yields all indices for holes
lastIndexOf from -0 returns +0 (matches Node; || 0 fast path)
lastIndexOf from 0.5 truncates to 0 and scans down
